name: Mangos
description: Sunny, juicy flesh wrapped around a flat stone. Judge ripeness by feel, because skin color varies by variety.

storage.label: Ripe
storage.advice: Move a ripe mango into the fridge when it gives slightly to gentle pressure.
storage.caution: Skin color alone does not tell you whether it is ripe.

storage.label: Unripe
storage.advice: Let a firm mango ripen at room temperature and check it daily.
storage.caution: Do not refrigerate before it has ripened.

storage.label: Cut
storage.advice: Wash the fruit before peeling or cutting; keep the prepared flesh chilled.
storage.caution: Keep cut produce separate from raw meat.

buying: Choose a slightly yielding mango for eating soon.
A firmer fruit can finish ripening at home.
freshness: Avoid damaged fruit and discard any that looks rotten. Ripeness is about texture, not a guarantee of safety.
leftovers: Blend into a smoothie or yogurt bowl.
tips: A ripe mango should give a little, much like a ripe peach.

freezing.instructions: Peel and cut ripe mango into pieces. Freeze on a tray, then put into a sealed freezer container.
freezing.quality: Use thawed pieces in smoothies or purées; the texture will be softer.
